title: Gaussian polynomial map into $L^p$
statement: Let $ br^n$ carry standard Gaussian measure, let $ bf$ be a field of scalars that is either $ br$ or $ bc$, and let $p$ be a finite nonnegative extended real number. Polynomial evaluation on $ rr^n$ defines a $ bf$-linear map from $ bf[X_1,mldots,X_n]$ to $L^p( rr^n, bf)$, sending each polynomial to its equivalence class as a function under Gaussian measure.
hypotheses_covered: $ bf$ is an RCLike scalar field
the domain consists of multivariate polynomials indexed by $ in n$
the target is $L^p$ for standard Gaussian measure
